title: feat(spec)!: refuse two entries under one identity in one package at the composition and package-body doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu6hTn2MxPVXtxBXndQYNLXw)_

Fixes #35228
Part of #35608

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches splitting one package's entries for one identity across sub-stacks or package bodies; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` teaches one `objectExtensions` entry per extension, and the refusal names both entries and prescribes the merge

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：应用作者把同一个包拆成几个模块再拼起来时，如果两个模块给同一个对象加字段（或者两个模块起了同名的页面、流程等），校验和构建现在会直接报错并点出两处位置；以前会悄悄只留后一处。
- 为什么做：有应用在同一个包里分两处给同一个对象加字段，前一处的字段无声消失，上线后读写才报字段不存在；这次按维护者裁决把"一个包里同一对象只能有一段扩展"在拼包和包内容处也管住，并把同类的其他元数据一起收口。
- 出错会怎样：已经构建、已经安装的包照常启动，只在启动日志里多一条错误提示；如果误拦了正常写法，作者会在校验时看到报错，撤回这个合并即可恢复原状，不涉及数据迁移。
- 要你做什么：无

Harness branch: this PR's head is `claude/project-thread-nbjebo` (harness-assigned, not `claude/issue-35228-…`), noted for the Duplicate Fix Guard workflow.

The folded card #35608 rides this PR; the seat finishes that card by hand after the merge.

## What changes

The ruling on #35228 (maintainer, letter A, runtime arm A1: 「推荐 A，已安装的包只记错误日志、照常启动。」) applied, with #35608 folded in:

- **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`.** The same-package identity table behind `defineStack`'s duplicate-entry refusal (all 29 keys: the 27 of the original refusal plus `queues` and `assignmentRules`) is now read by one helper, `duplicateEntryFindings`, at four doors, with one wording and per-door origins:
  - a stack's top level: `stack.KEY[i]` — byte-identical to before;
  - each `packages[i]` body of a `defineStack` call: `stack.packages[i].manifest.KEY[j]`;
  - the ONE package a flat `composeStacks` makes (every manifest strategy but `'preserve'`): the inputs' entries together, each labelled with its input (`'com.example.sales' (stack #0) objectExtensions[0]`). `objects` is skipped there, since two inputs declaring one object name is the `objectConflict` strategy's to refuse or fold;
  - the RESIDUAL package of any composition, under every manifest strategy including `'preserve'`: the top-level entries no body of the composed artifact claims, read by the boot's own residual reading (`isResidualTopLevelItem`, plus a claimed-by-identity rule for `datasources` and `objectExtensions`), judged as one package. A flat composition with no `packages[]` carries all its entries as residual. A nested multi-package input's flattened copies of its bodies are never read as a second entry;
  - every package body a composition carries or, under `'preserve'`, assembles, each judged on its own.
  One entry object reached through two inputs (one built sub-stack passed twice) counts once at the door, in every collection but `hooks`. In `hooks` a hook reached twice is refused: a built artifact serialises the two references into two equal hook entries and binds both handlers, while a source boot folds them, so accepting it would let one accepted composition behave differently between a source boot and a built boot (one bind against two). Counting hooks by position also makes the composition door agree with the single-stack door for hooks.
  The composition doors join `composeStacks`' artifact cross-reference pass, so the refusal is `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` / 422 and carries the inputs' conversion record like the other composition refusals. Cross-package reuse (ADR-0048 §3.4) is untouched; two bodies under one package id stay the boot's `DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE`.
- **`packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts` (A1).** The `objectExtensions` loop first logs, at `error`, once per (package, target) in a body carrying two or more entries for one target: the target, the package, every entry index, that only the last entry's fields register, and "merge them and rebuild". The line stays quiet when every entry for that target is equal by value (one sub-stack composed twice, as composed or as built JSON); equal entries beside one that differs still log, naming every entry. The outcome is unchanged: nothing refused, nothing merged. `registry-object-registration.ts` (the replace-on-reload splice) is not touched.
- **Migration entry** `stack-package-duplicate-entry-refused-at-every-door` (semantic, protocol 18) and one changeset (`@objectstack/spec` + `@objectstack/objectql`, `minor`, BREAKING banner, `adr-0087: registered`).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack-object-extension-duplicate-target.test.ts` (#35228): composed stack with two `objectExtensions` entries for one target refused with the exact message naming both; every flat manifest pick (`first`, `last`, an index) refused; a hand-built `packages[1]` body refused at `stack.packages[1].manifest.objectExtensions[0] and …[1]`; a nested artifact's body refused under `last` and `preserve`; a loose input under `preserve` refused as its body; the single-stack message pinned byte for byte; controls: `preserve` with two packages each extending one target, two hand-built bodies, one package extending two targets, the same sub-stack passed twice. Added on review: `preserve` with two manifest-less inputs declaring page `home`, and two extensions for one target, both refused naming both, plus the body-slot control (S2); a `preserve` artifact with two packages each extending one target, nested in a flat and in a `preserve` composition, accepted, and the nested artifact's own residual pair refused (S1); a hook reached twice refused (S3).
- `packages/spec/src/stack-compose-duplicate-entry-census.test.ts` (#35608): the census as a table-driven test over the 29 keys — each input accepted alone; flat composition refused per key (28 by this check, `objects` by its object-conflict refusal); a `packages[0]` body refused per key; cross-package control under `preserve` accepted per key with one entry in each body.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-same-target-object-extensions-log.test.ts` (A1): one error line naming both entries, the earlier field absent and the later served (today's outcome); once per (package, target); controls (one entry; two packages); reload pin — re-registering with a renamed field serves the new name and not the old. Added on review (S3): the accepted twice-passed sub-stack composition, registered as composed and as built JSON, logs no error; equal entries beside a differing one log.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-conversions-record.test.ts`: the composition duplicate refusal carries its inputs' conversion records.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-datasource-connector.test.ts`: fixture triage. Two flat-composition fixtures declare one connector name in two inputs; that is now also the one composed package's duplicate, so they assert the second finding, and the reversed-order control now asserts the refusal. A `preserve` fixture now also meets the residual duplicate finding (second issue of the same envelope).

## Acceptance notes

- Census on base `e91d9671` (before the fix), `composeStacks([A, B])` default strategy, A with the manifest and the first entry, B the second: 26 keys ACCEPTED with 2 entries; `objects` REFUSED `STACK_COMPOSE_OBJECT_CONFLICT`; `apps` REFUSED `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`. After: all 29 refused (28 `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, which runs before the single-app count as in `defineStack`; `objects` unchanged). A boot census (which entry is served) was not repeated: the original duplicate-entry card measured it for the same collections and registrars.
- Under `'preserve'`, a manifest-less input contributes no body; its entries are the residual package, which the residual door now judges (review S2).
- Accepted deviation (review N2): the refusal's remedy does not mention manifest `'preserve'`, because the #22934 sentence stays byte-identical at every door.
- Out of scope, filed as #35711 (with review N5, a residual job judged by no door): a residual (top-level, unclaimed) `objectExtensions` entry of a packages-carrying artifact is registered by no door at boot (scratch probe on `c5b827e5`: the extended field absent on the resolved target). So at that door the refusal's sentence ("only the last entry's fields register") overstates what registers: none do. The refusal itself stands.
- The connector-lend rule's flattened-artifact branch now always arrives beside the duplicate finding for a flat composition; it is kept as it was.
- The A1 line is once per registration of a body; a reload of the same unfixed body logs it again.
- `stack.zod.ts`'s docblock above the table now says 29 collections (review N1); objects stay with `objectConflict`, and the app pair answers `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` (review N3).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local src/stack-object-extension-duplicate-target.test.ts` passes; then delete the line `...collectComposedResidualDuplicateEntryErrors(stacks, composed.packages),` in `stack.zod.ts` and rerun: the flat-composition and residual cases go red.

Read first, by risk: `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` (the `duplicateEntryFindings` family and the two lines added to `composeBuiltStacks` step 3b), `packages/spec/src/stack-datasource-connector.test.ts` (the re-judged fixtures), `packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts` (`logSameTargetObjectExtensions`).
